blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Supreme Court has reduced the offense and the penalty meted on a former public school principal in San Jose, Occidental Mindoro over an unauthorized cutting of trees. The high tribunal, in a decision on June 2 released only on Thursday, partially granted the petition sought by Melencio Corpuz. Corpuz was found guilty of grave misconduct, simple neglect of duty, and simple misconduct by the Office of the Ombudsman and, later, by the Court of Appeals.
